claims.permitted_wording: A persistent transit-like signal is present at the official ephemeris in six 120-s TESS sectors.
The folded circular fit supplies a descriptive scale reference, not an adopted native-cadence posterior.
A giant-companion scale is conditional on a planetary event on TIC 81077799 and the catalog single-star assumptions.
Formal sector depths are heterogeneous, and the cause is not assigned.
